ui.coverageTip: How much of the active profile weight is backed by available bench scores. Composite is reduced by sqrt(coverage) so cherry-picked single-test scores cannot outrank broader, verified ones.
ui.disputedTip: Cells in the active preset that have same-tier source disagreement (≥3pp inside one tier on top of the ≥5pp BLOCK threshold). The composite carries a confidence haircut for these — capped at 5pp per cell so a single extreme outlier cannot dominate. Cross-tier disputes (e.g. I-tier vs S-tier) are not counted because autoResolveWinner already picked the higher-trust source.

opus-4-7.strengths: SWE-bench Pro leader (64.3%), top MCP-Atlas tool use (77.3%), 1M context, highest vision resolution (3.75MP), 70% on CursorBench
opus-4-7.weaknesses: Premium price ($5/$25 per MTok), aaIdx (57) matches GPT-5.4 at 5x the cost

sonnet-4-6.strengths: Office productivity leader (1633 Elo), 98% of Opus 4.7 performance at 20% of the cost, major ARC-AGI-2 leap (58.3%), 1M context, context compaction
sonnet-4-6.weaknesses: Trails Opus 4.7 on deep scientific reasoning (GPQA: 74.1% vs 94.2%), SWE-bench Pro score not published

qwen-3-6-27b.strengths: 27B dense model in same family as 35B MoE variant. 262K context. Good local alternative to 35B A3B. Strong coding and general reasoning.
qwen-3-6-27b.weaknesses: Insufficient independent benchmark data. 35B A3B MoE variant generally preferred for same use case. Pricing not disclosed.

kimi-k2-6.strengths: SWE-Pro 58.6 highest among open-weight models. HLE-Full with Tools 54.0 surpasses GPT-5.4 and Claude. 300 concurrent sub-agents, 4000-step coordinated agent swarm. LiveCodeBench v6 89.6% leading.
kimi-k2-6.weaknesses: Modified MIT license imposes some commercial restrictions. Lags frontier on math and GPQA reasoning. Benchmark harness choice can shift scores by several points.

deepseek-v4-flash.strengths: 284B total / 13B active MoE, MIT license. $0.14 input — cheapest frontier-class model available. SWE-Verified 79.0% only 1.6pts behind Pro. 1M token context with 10% less KV cache.
deepseek-v4-flash.weaknesses: Negligible gap vs Pro for most dev workloads but falls behind on tasks requiring maximum reasoning. Local deployment still needs substantial hardware. Text-only.

deepseek-v3-2.strengths: 671B total MoE at extremely competitive price ($0.28 input). SWE-Verified consistent 72-74% validated across multiple frameworks. Open-weight, long-context optimized with DeepSeek Sparse Attention.
deepseek-v3-2.weaknesses: V4-Pro displaced it April 2026. Context window only 128K vs V4's 1M. Score inconsistency between Speciale variant and standard model.

qwen3-coder-30b.strengths: 30B total / 3.3B active MoE at $0.07/M input — extremely cheap. 262K context window, 107 t/s. Easy local setup with Ollama/LMStudio/llama.cpp support.
qwen3-coder-30b.weaknesses: AA Intelligence Index 20 below average for current competitive field. SWE-Bench score not independently verified. Superseded by newer Qwen3.6-35B-A3B for most use cases.

devstral-2.strengths: SOTA open-weight coding agent, SWE-Verified 72.2%. 256K context, available on Ollama. Companion Devstral Small 2 (24B) runs single-GPU. Mistral Vibe CLI integration.
devstral-2.weaknesses: 123B dense model requires minimum 4x H100-class GPUs. SWE-bench Verified score not yet verified on official leaderboard. Commercial license required for revenue >$20M.

glm-5-1.strengths: SWE-Pro 58.4 surpasses GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6. NL2Repo 42.7% leads full-repo generation. Up to 8-hour autonomous task execution. Trained 100% on Huawei Ascend 910B domestic chips. MIT license open-weight.
glm-5-1.weaknesses: GPQA Diamond 86.2% lags frontier (Claude 94.3%). No SWE-Bench Verified independent AA score. 744B total / 40B active — local deployment practically impossible.

llama-4-scout.strengths: 10M token context (largest open-weight Apr 2026); MoE 17B/109B; lcbV6=32.8; open weights; GPQA 57.2%
llama-4-scout.weaknesses: Reliable context ~5-6.5M per NVIDIA RULER; no SWE-bench score; aaIdx=14 low; below Maverick across all benchmarks

llama-4-maverick.strengths: MoE architecture (17B active / 400B total); 1M token context; lcbV6=43.4 outperforms GPT-4o (32.3); GPQA 69.8%; open weights
llama-4-maverick.weaknesses: No SWE-bench Verified score on Tier-I sources; experimental chat version vs public release controversy; aaIdx=18 below frontier median

qwen3-coder-next.strengths: 80B total / 3B active hybrid attention+MoE architecture. Runs locally on single RTX 5090. 256K context, 370+ languages. SWE-Verified 58.7% beats models with 10-20x more active params.
qwen3-coder-next.weaknesses: API pricing not finalized. No SWE-Pro independent measurement. Overshadowed by Qwen3-Coder-480B. Not optimized for FIM/autocomplete.

minimax-m2-7.strengths: Frontier-class quality at the lowest price among open-weight peers ($0.30 input). Strong agentic coding on SWE-Bench and Terminal-Bench. Top AA Intelligence Index at half median market price.
minimax-m2-7.weaknesses: Output throughput below class at 45.7 t/s. High TTFT (2.18s). Limited provider diversity outside MiniMax platform.

minimax-m2-5.strengths: 80.2% on SWE-Bench Verified matches top closed-source models. Output speed 105 t/s — double class median. 230B total / 10B active MoE runs efficiently.
minimax-m2-5.weaknesses: AA Intelligence Index 42 lags M2.7's 50. SWE-Pro and Terminal-Bench independent verification missing. Superseded by M2.7; now secondary option.

mimo-v2-flash.strengths: Open-source MIT, 309B total / 15B active MoE. 1M token context. 73.4% SWE-Bench Verified surpasses Claude Sonnet 4.5. 94.1% AIME 2025 math.
mimo-v2-flash.weaknesses: API pricing not publicly confirmed. No SWE-Pro independent measure. Quickly overshadowed by V2-Pro and V2.5 families.

mimo-v2-pro.strengths: 1T total / 42B active MoE, 78% SWE-Bench Verified surpasses Claude Sonnet 4.6. 1M token context ideal for agentic workflows. Well below frontier pricing. Viral 'Hunter Alpha' stealth launch.
mimo-v2-pro.weaknesses: Weights not released (API only). Price doubles above 256K context. SWE-Pro independent measurement missing. V2.5-Pro began superseding it April 2026.

mimo-v2-5-pro.strengths: Matches frontier models at 40-60% fewer tokens per trajectory. SWE-Pro 57.2, ClawEval 63.8, τ³-Bench 72.9. Multimodal (image/audio/video+text) in one model. Perfect compiler task in 4.3h / 672 tool calls.
mimo-v2-5-pro.weaknesses: Weights not yet open-source ('soon' promised). Public beta first, full API scaling in progress. SWE-Pro score self-reported.

mimo-v2-5.strengths: Fast everyday model at 100-150 t/s. 50% fewer tokens vs Muse Spark. All modalities at $0.40 input competitive price. Consolidates V2-Pro + V2-Omni into one.
mimo-v2-5.weaknesses: Exact parameter count not separately disclosed (may share with Pro). Benchmark scores not independently verified. Weights not yet open-source.

step-3-5-flash.strengths: Open-source 196B total / 11B active MoE. 100-350 t/s generation throughput. SWE-Verified 74.4%, τ²-Bench 88.2 strong agentic coding. $0.10/$0.30 among cheapest available.
step-3-5-flash.weaknesses: All benchmarks self-reported (StepFun). High VRAM for local run via vLLM/llama.cpp. Limited independent platform verification.

deepseek-v4-pro.strengths: 1.6T total / 49B active MoE, open-weight MIT. SWE-Verified 80.6% (0.2pts from Claude Opus 4.6), LiveCodeBench 93.5%. 73% fewer FLOPs vs V3.2, 1M token context, well below frontier pricing.
deepseek-v4-pro.weaknesses: Minimum 8x H100 80GB GPUs to run locally. Throughput-limited at preview launch. HLE 37.7% lags frontier. Text-only — no image/audio support.

qwen3-coder-480b.strengths: SOTA among open weights on agentic coding. Aider Polyglot 61.8% matches Claude Sonnet 4. 7.5T token (70% code) training, 358 programming languages. QwenCode CLI open-sourced.
qwen3-coder-480b.weaknesses: 480B total parameters makes local deployment impractical (multiple H100 nodes required). 256K context window restricted vs rivals offering 1M. No thinking mode.

devstral-medium.strengths: 24B params, Apache 2.0, runs on 32GB RAM laptop. SWE-Verified 68% strong local coding. Multimodal (image input supported). $0.10/$0.30 affordable pricing.
devstral-medium.weaknesses: 4.2pts behind Devstral 2 123B. No image output. Local performance requires 32GB+ RAM for full precision.

codestral-22b.strengths: HumanEval 86.6%, MBPP 91.2%. 256K context ideal for repo-scale code completion. Runs full-precision on RTX 4090 at 22B params. FIM support excellent for IDE integration.
codestral-22b.weaknesses: Non-commercial license restricts startup adoption. No SWE-Bench Verified independent score. Overshadowed by newer agentic models like Devstral and Qwen3-Coder.

nemotron-3-super.strengths: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer (LatentMoE) delivers 5x throughput. NVFP4 runs on 64GB VRAM (single H100 SXM). SWE-Verified 60.5% open-weight record at launch. 91.75% RULER at 1M tokens. Free on Cloudflare Workers AI.
nemotron-3-super.weaknesses: SWE-Verified 60.5% superseded by April 2026 by DeepSeek V4-Pro (80.6%) and Kimi K2.6 (80.2%). Significant 45.8% drop on non-English coding. Full BF16 weights require 3-4x H100.

gemma-4-e2b.strengths: 2.3B effective params (5.1B total via PLE); native multimodal (text/image/audio); offline-capable; 48 tok/s on mobile; Apache 2.0
gemma-4-e2b.weaknesses: Edge model — not benchmarked on SWE-bench/agentic; lcbV6=44.0 single C-tier source; aaIdx=15 low; vLLM FlashAttention fallback slowdown

gemma-4-e4b.strengths: 4.5B effective; native multimodal with audio ASR; M-series Mac 40+ tok/s; T4-GPU deployable; Apache 2.0; lcbV6=52.0 strong for size
gemma-4-e4b.weaknesses: Edge model — not benchmarked on SWE-bench; lcbV6=52.0 single C-tier source; aaIdx=15 shared with E2B; ~9 tok/s on RTX 4090 via vLLM

gemma-4-26b-moe.strengths: 26B total / 3.8B active MoE, runs on RTX 4090 with 24GB (Q4). Arena AI global #6. AIME 2026 88.3% impressive for efficiency. Delivers 97% of 31B Dense quality at 1/8 compute.
gemma-4-26b-moe.weaknesses: SWE-Verified 64% lags GLM-5.1 (78%) and Claude (87.6%). Still requires ~26GB to load (despite only 3.8B active). Not preferred over 31B Dense for coding agent scenarios.

gemma-4-31b.strengths: Best US open model under Apache 2.0. Arena AI #3 (Elo 1452). AIME 2026 89.2% strong math. τ²-Bench 86.4 impressive agent performance. 256K context. Full multimodal.
gemma-4-31b.weaknesses: SWE-Verified 64% lags Chinese models like GLM-5.1 and Kimi K2.6. Full precision requires 80GB H100. Pricing not yet disclosed (Google AI Studio free preview).

gemma-3-27b.strengths: 27B dense model runs single-GPU full precision. Extremely cheap at $0.10/1M input on DeepInfra. 140+ languages, image+text multimodal. Good fine-tuning base.
gemma-3-27b.weaknesses: LiveCodeBench v6 29.1% far too low by current coding standards. Gemma 4 dramatically superseded it April 2026 (Codeforces ELO: 110 vs 2150). Agentic tool use 6.6% unacceptably low.

qwen25-coder-32b.strengths: 14.7M Ollama downloads — #1 choice for local coding. HumanEval 92.7%, Aider 73.7%. Best FIM autocomplete model. Runs on RTX 4090 with Q4_K_M at 22GB VRAM.
qwen25-coder-32b.weaknesses: 32K context window limited by modern standards (Unsloth 128K version exists). Weak on agentic coding vs Qwen3.6 family. Text-only, not multimodal.

qwen25-coder-14b.strengths: 9GB file size — strong coding on 12GB VRAM GPUs (RTX 3060/4060). FIM support ideal for IDE autocomplete. Apache 2.0 license allows free commercial use.
qwen25-coder-14b.weaknesses: 32K context window limited. Benchmark performance drops vs 32B variant. 32B or higher preferred for agentic coding.

qwen25-coder-7b.strengths: 4.7GB size runs on 8GB VRAM GPUs (RX 580, GTX 1070). FIM support for lightweight IDE integration. Apache 2.0. Best choice for entry-level local coding.
qwen25-coder-7b.weaknesses: 32K context and 7B params can't handle serious agentic tasks. Upgrade to 14B or 32B on stronger hardware. Benchmark figures significantly below 32B.

deepseek-coder-v2-16b.strengths: 16B MoE variant 8.9GB runs on 12GB VRAM. 160K context window quite wide for local models. GPT4-Turbo-comparable performance at release. 2.4M Ollama downloads.
deepseek-coder-v2-16b.weaknesses: Significantly superseded by 2024+ newer models. 236B variant impractical to run locally (133GB). License is DeepSeek-specific, not Apache/MIT.

deepseek-r1-14b.strengths: Distilled from Qwen2.5, strong reasoning with 128K context. MIT license. 9GB size comfortable on 12GB VRAM GPUs. Popular for local mathematical reasoning.
deepseek-r1-14b.weaknesses: Distilled model — not at full R1 671B capability. Coding benchmark scores not independently reported. Superseded by DeepSeek V4 family.

qwen-3-6-max.strengths: AA Intelligence Index 52 strong ranking. #1 on 6 benchmarks: SWE-Pro, Terminal-Bench 2.0, SkillsBench, QwenClawBench, QwenWebBench, SciCode. preserve_thinking for agentic workflows.
qwen-3-6-max.weaknesses: Closed-weight (first time in Qwen history). SWE-Bench Verified independent score not published. Pricing not finalized during preview. Text-only — no image/audio.

gpt-5-4.strengths: Foundation of GPT-5.4 series, wide context (1M token), accessible pricing, ChatGPT Plus access
gpt-5-4.weaknesses: Superseded by GPT-5.4 and o3 in OpenAI's lineup, limited independent benchmark data available

qwen3-6-35b-moe.strengths: 35B total / 3B active MoE, Apache 2.0. SWE-Verified 73.4% exceptional among open-weights. Runs on 24GB Apple Silicon Mac with Unsloth 4-bit. GPQA Diamond 86.0 strong multi-discipline performance.
qwen3-6-35b-moe.weaknesses: API pricing not yet disclosed. No SWE-Pro independent measurement. Full F16 model ~72GB (beyond consumer hardware).

o4-mini.strengths: Top-tier reasoning at 10x lower cost than o3; SWE-bench Verified 58.6% (Vellum independent) / 68.1% (OpenAI scaffold); GPQA Diamond 81.4%; LiveCodeBench 80.2%; Codeforces ELO 2719
o4-mini.weaknesses: SWE-bench score varies by scaffold (OpenAI 68.1 vs Vellum 58.6 — RED, conservative 58.6 chosen); no aaIdx entry on Artificial Analysis; closed-weight, no local deployment

grok-3-mini.strengths: aaIdx=32 (well above price-tier median); GPQA Diamond 79.1%; LiveCodeBench 69.6% (conservative baseline); 183 tok/s; $0.30/$0.50 per 1M — strong cost-efficiency
grok-3-mini.weaknesses: No SWE-bench Verified score on any Tier-I source; lcbV6 single-source xAI (RED — 69.6 vs 80.4 same-source conflict); xAI does not submit to SWE-bench / SEAL

gemini-3-1-flash.strengths: 1M token context, $0.15-$0.30/M input — 4x cheaper than Pro. GPQA 86.9% strong science reasoning. Fastest Google model for high-volume production; free tier on AI Studio.
gemini-3-1-flash.weaknesses: No SWE-bench Verified or LiveCodeBench independent score found. Proprietary, closed-weight. Trails Pro by ~5pp on most reasoning benchmarks.

gemini-3-1-pro.strengths: 1M context, SWE-V 80.6% matches DeepSeek V4-Pro, GPQA 94.3% world-class, LCB 88.49%, SWE-Pro 46.1%, MCP-Atlas 73.9%. $2/$12 per 1M — best Google value at frontier.
gemini-3-1-pro.weaknesses: HLE 44.4% lags Claude Opus 4.7 (46.9%) and MiMo-V2.5-Pro (48.0%). No aaAgentic, tb2, tau2 independent scores. Proprietary closed-weight, no local deployment.

gpt-4-1.strengths: SWE-V 54.6% strong for its tier, 1M context, $2/$8 per 1M with $0.50 cache hits. Multimodal (video+text). 83% cost reduction vs GPT-4o. ChatGPT Plus accessible.
gpt-4-1.weaknesses: No GPQA, LCB, or SWE-Pro independent scores found. Superseded by o3 and o4-mini on reasoning tasks. Proprietary, closed-weight. Video-MME 72% is baseline not SOTA.

grok-3.strengths: GPQA 84.6% strong science reasoning, LCB 79.4% coding, 1M token context (8x prior), AIME 2025 93.3%. Chatbot Arena Elo ~1402 at launch. $3/$15 per 1M.
grok-3.weaknesses: No SWE-bench Verified or SWE-Pro score on any Tier-I source. Benchmark controversy: multi-attempt averages inflate scores vs single-attempt peers. xAI does not submit to SEAL.

mistral-large-3.strengths: 675B total / 41B active MoE, LCB 82.8% strong coding, HumanEval 92.0%, AIME 2025 88.0%, MATH-500 93.6%. Self-hostable open-weight. $0.50/$1.50 affordable pricing.
mistral-large-3.weaknesses: GPQA 43.9% significantly below peer open-weight models (DeepSeek 77%+, Kimi 80%+). No SWE-bench Verified independent score. Trails frontier on agentic and scientific reasoning.

o3.strengths: SWE-V 71.7%, GPQA 87.7%, AIME 96.7%, Codeforces Elo 2727, ARC-AGI 87.5%. $2/$8 per 1M after 80% price cut March 2026. Best-in-class reasoning track model from OpenAI.
o3.weaknesses: Reasoning tokens billed as output (hidden cost: 500 visible tokens may consume 2000+ billed). ARC-AGI-2 only 2.9%. No SWE-Pro Tier-I score. Closed-weight, no local deployment.

qwen3-235b.strengths: 235B total / 22B active MoE, Apache 2.0. LCB 74.8%, GPQA 81.1%, AIME 2025 92.3%, AIME 2024 85.7%. Rivals Gemini 2.5 Pro. $0.20/$1.00 per 1M — 70% below GPT-5 price.
qwen3-235b.weaknesses: LCB 74.8% trails newer frontier models (Gemini 3.1 Pro 88.5%, DeepSeek V4-Pro 93.5%). No SWE-bench Verified independent score. Local deployment requires multiple H100 nodes.

qwen3-32b.strengths: 32B dense, Apache 2.0. $0.15/$0.75 per 1M — cheapest frontier-grade dense model. 119 languages, strong multilingual coding. Fits single A100 or high-end consumer GPU at Q4.
qwen3-32b.weaknesses: SWE-bench Pro only 3.4% (trails even GPT-4o 4.9%). No GPQA or LCB independent Tier-I score found. Smaller than 235B MoE sibling — lower ceiling on complex reasoning tasks.

qwen3-6-plus.strengths: Rebuilt reasoning layer uses always-on chain-of-thought. 515 fewer reasoning tokens vs Qwen 3.5 Plus while producing more output. Improved consistency and production reliability over predecessor.
qwen3-6-plus.weaknesses: No independent GPQA, SWE-bench, or LiveCodeBench scores found. Weaker than 3.5 Plus on multimodal audio/video tasks. Pricing not officially disclosed on major provider APIs.

devstral-small-2.strengths: 24B params, SWE-V 68.0% — strongest open-weight at size class. 256K context, Apache 2.0, multimodal image input. Runs on RTX 4090 (24GB) or 32GB Mac. 75 tok/s, TTFT 1.18s. $0.10/$0.30.
devstral-small-2.weaknesses: 4.2pp behind Devstral 2 (123B). No SWE-Pro or LCB independent score. Limited provider availability vs larger Devstral 2. Image output not supported.

gpt-5-5.strengths: Leads Terminal-Bench 2.0 at 82.7%; GPQA 93.6%; 1M token context; natively omnimodal; MCP-Atlas 75.3%; SWE-bench Pro 58.6%.
gpt-5-5.weaknesses: 5.7 points behind Opus 4.7 on SWE-bench Pro; HLE 41.4% (vs Opus 4.7 46.9%); expensive at $5/$30 per 1M tokens; closed weights.
